name: Easier Waypoints
summary: See the lane and its direction before placing a waypoint, for every line type.
description:
One road. One direction. No guesswork.

Easier Waypoints shows where a waypoint will go before you place it. It highlights the lane under the cursor, draws the direction of travel, and names the stretch of the line you are editing. The game's own Line Manager still saves every change.

HOW TO USE
Select a line in the Line Manager, then the stretch you want to edit. Press Add Waypoint above the stop list, point at the lane the vehicles should use and click. Or click the line's route to add a waypoint to that part of the line. Each click adds the next waypoint in order, and the Line Manager stays open so you can watch the list grow; use Finish Waypoints, right-click or press Esc to finish. Waypoint rows in the stop list name the road and the heading. The other side of a road runs the other way, so move the cursor across to change direction. Ships and aircraft get a marker instead of a lane. You can still hold the key shown in the game's prompt and click, as in the base game; the tooltips now say so.

LIMITS
This is an experimental build that has not yet been verified in-game. Arrows only appear when the road's own lane data confirms the direction. Tracks are shown as usable both ways, because the route decides. Ambiguous route picks and large differences from terrain height are refused; pick the road or track directly, or finish and use the game's waypoint key. The full route is not predicted; route problems appear in the stop list after placing. Other mods that change the Line Manager's waypoint tooltip, stop panel or stop rows may conflict.

CHANGES

v0.2.0 — Experimental placement tool for every line type
Add Waypoint button with a lane and direction preview for road, tram, rail, ship and air lines; click the route to add a waypoint to that part of the line. Arrows only when lane data confirms the direction. The correct stretch is shown when no stretch is selected. Tooltips explain the precision-mode key. A compact stop panel button in the game's style. Says so when a preview can't be drawn. Waypoint rows refresh road names and headings and keep long text inside the name field. Finish Waypoints shows when placement is active. Placement uses the displayed target and refuses stale or ambiguous picks. No custom save data.

v0.1.0 — Experimental direction preview
Candidate road lane highlight, directional chevrons, clearer placement guidance and selected-segment context. No simulation commands or custom save data.
